dataset.what: Selfies and outfit shots the team took on phone 0.5x lenses, every person signed a release.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbwide05 style, " and goes on in one or two long sentences (Z-Image style): who or what is in the picture, where, the light and the framing.
Describe the scene, never the look the LoRA learns (no "grainy", "film look" or the like), so the trigger carries it.
No names of people, places that identify someone, brands, camera models or photographers.
